_source: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.48–49 (Haunts of Utrebant Clash) — owner PDF 2026-11-15
steps: Monster Positioning: Put numbered base rings on all Haunt of Utrebant miniatures. Randomly place Haunt of Utrebant miniatures numbered 1–3 on the spaces designated on the diagram. Note the facing direction indicated by the arrows. Then, place 3 BP 1 cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–3 on the Mob track.
Additional Setup: Place the Fool's deck near the Monster Sheet. Follow additional Clash Setup instructions introduced by Traits (if any).
Aftermath Loot: Victorious Search — Clash Scavenge 1 and Scavenge 3; Forlorn Search — Scavenge 3.
